summary: feat(settings): use small button for skip on pairing QR screen
description:
Because:

- The "Skip for now" button on the version 2 desktop to mobile pair
  flow QR screen should use the small button variant, 32px tall.

This commit:

- Replaces the default neutral button padding with small sizing
  (text-xs, py-1, px-5), matching small neutral buttons elsewhere in
  Settings.
- Adds min-h-8 so the button is at least 32px tall while still growing
  to fit longer translated labels. Width stays content-sized.

Closes #FXA-14628
